name: application-metric-sparkline-card
title: Metric Sparkline Card
description: KPI tile pairing a big number and delta badge with an inline sparkline trend, computed from a typed points array without a charting library.
useWhen: Showing a KPI alongside its recent trend, not just its current value.
Building a dashboard summary row where each metric needs a lightweight visual trend, not a full chart.
You want a self-contained SVG sparkline instead of pulling in a charting library for a small trend line.
avoidWhen: The metric has no meaningful time-series trend to show — use application-stat-tile instead.
The data needs axes, tooltips, or zoom — use application-charts instead.
More than one series must be compared on the same chart — a sparkline is single-series only.
responsiveBehavior: The card has a fixed width intended for a dashboard grid; the sparkline SVG uses preserveAspectRatio='none' and scales to the card's width at any breakpoint.
accessibility: The sparkline SVG carries role='img' and an aria-label summarizing the trend's start and end values in words.
Growth direction uses both an icon and a text delta, not color alone.

variants.title: Area sparkline
variants.description: KPI tile with an area-fill sparkline, for a rising or falling trend with a filled visual weight.
accessibility: The sparkline's aria-label states the trend's direction and range in words, not just visually.

variants.title: Area sparkline (Dark)
variants.description: Area-fill sparkline KPI tile adapted for dark dashboard surfaces.
accessibility: Value, label, and delta badge colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Line sparkline
variants.description: KPI tile with a line-only sparkline and a marker dot on the latest value.
accessibility: The marker dot is supplementary; the aria-label already states the latest value in words.

variants.title: Line sparkline (Dark)
variants.description: Line-only sparkline KPI tile adapted for dark dashboard surfaces.
accessibility: Line and marker colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
